item.title: Jackie Chan’s dollar-by-dollar school campaign raises over $192,000 for rural Chinese children
item.description: Jackie Chan transformed the act of giving into a global movement, urging fans to pitch in small donations for constructing schools in rural China. After six years, the initiative garnered over $96,000, which Chan generously matched, resulting in a remarkable total of over $192,000. This remarkable effort not only facilitated multiple school buildings but also underscored the power of collective action in uplifting communities through education. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
